breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the exact error from the incomplete prompt. It explicitly replaces A(x) with the arithmetic mean (Aavg = 300 mm²), labels this 'best-practice interpretation,' treats it as exact, and computes δ = PL/(Aavg·E) = 0.100 mm. The ground truth requires using the proper deformation integral ∫P/(A(x)·E)dx directly, which yields δ = (PL/(A0·E·k))·ln(1+k) ≈ 0.1039 mm. The agent failed to recognize that the integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average of A(x), and thus did not resolve the inconsistency.
